title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Thighs with Roasted Vegetables
description: Bone-in chicken thighs roasted on a single sheet pan with potatoes, zucchini, and cherry tomatoes until the skin crackles and the vegetables caramelize. The kind of dinner that makes a Tuesday feel handled.

steps.text: Heat oven to 425°F. Line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment paper or foil.

Toss potatoes, zucchini, red onion, cherry tomatoes, and garlic with 2 tablespoons olive oil, half the salt, and a few grinds of pepper. Spread in an even layer on the sheet pan, leaving some room for the chicken.

Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels — this is non-negotiable for crispy skin. Season on both sides with smoked paprika, oregano, remaining salt, and pepper. Nestle thighs skin-side up among the vegetables.
Drizzle the remaining tablespoon of olive oil over the chicken skin.

Roast until the chicken skin is deeply golden and crisp, the juices run clear, and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads 165°F, 35 to 40 minutes. The potatoes should be fork-tender and the tomatoes will have burst.
Squeeze lemon wedges over everything at the table.
